name: Opt-Out Disclosure
description: If a controller sells personal data to third parties or processes personal data for targeted advertising, the controller shall clearly and conspicuously disclose such processing, as well as the manner in which a consumer may exercise the right to opt out of such processing (§ 59.1-578(D)).

name: Secure and Reliable Request Means
description: One or more secure and reliable means, established and described in a privacy notice, for consumers to submit a request to exercise their consumer rights, including the right to opt out. Controllers shall not require a consumer to create a new account in order to exercise consumer rights but may require use of an existing account (§ 59.1-578(E)).
